metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace where Microsoft Sentinel is enabled.

properties.displayName: High-Risk OAuth Permission Consent Granted in Microsoft Entra ID
properties.description: Detects consent grants assigning high-privilege Graph or mail/file read permissions to enterprise applications or AI integrations, which can expose sensitive data if abused. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1504, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-25-protect-organisations-ai-services.
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName in ("Consent to application", "Add delegated permission grant", "Add app role assignment to service principal")
| where Result == "success"
| extend ModifiedProps = tostring(TargetResources)
| where ModifiedProps has_any ("Mail.Read", "Files.Read.All", "Sites.Read.All", "Directory.ReadWrite.All", "RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory")
| extend InitiatingUser = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend TargetAppName = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, InitiatingUser, TargetAppName, ModifiedProps
